# The on-call person rejects the proposal. Nothing is written: no saved state, no mitigation. The ops system gets the state rejected, and a person owns the incident.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=60
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
exec obeereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'paused: [primary] Approve rollback'
exec obeereal answer incident-2 reject: the deploy is not the cause
wait
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

! exists writes.log
! exists home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/before.json
grep '^incident-2 rejected$' status.log
grep 'rejected by primary: reject: the deploy is not the cause' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
! exists home/.incident/postmortems/incident-2.md
! grep postmortem calls.log

-- body.txt --
The watch.
